checks.causality: No infection, treatment benefit or causal lab contribution claimed.
checks.selection: Conditional on culture orders and adult cohort; later cohorts already viewed.
checks.collider_and_history_conditioning: H90-negative analysis is conditional; no etiologic inference.
checks.base_rate: Report AP, event prevalence, known nonpositive and unknown alerts separately.
checks.missingness: Known-outcome calibration does not resolve missing outcomes; S8 uncertainty remains.
checks.multiple_comparisons: Pointwise intervals, no multiplicity correction or confirmatory claim.
checks.winner_selection: D18 chosen after exploratory model comparisons; frozen supplement plan cannot reverse prior access.
checks.subgroup_heterogeneity: Stratum CI crossing patterns do not constitute an interaction test.
checks.time_and_information: T0 metadata proxies and first-positive capture do not establish earlier clinical detection.
checks.workload: Fixed-threshold workloads differ; no same-cost superiority claim from workflow figure.
checks.equivalence: Ablation and after90 intervals containing zero do not establish equivalence.
